powers: Capito chairs the Environment and Public Works Committee, which has jurisdiction over federal permitting, the Clean Air and Clean Water Acts, and is a central venue for permitting reform; she also sits on Appropriations, Commerce and Rules. implications: Analysis: Rated safely Republican, this seat is unlikely to affect chamber control; its main significance is who fills the seat and which committees they join. Her re-election would likely preserve her EPW leadership if Republicans keep the majority; if Democrats win control she would likely become ranking member.
